# Shared cases for fetch_url_host and fetch_url_display, run by
# tests/fetch_test.sh and ps/tests/fetch_test.ps1: both must agree.
# Format: input|host|display. "=" as display means the input itself.
# Escapes in input: \t tab, \n newline, \\ backslash, \u00ad soft hyphen.
https://github.com/o/r|github.com|=
https://user:pw@example.com:8443/a/b|example.com|(URL not shown)

HTTPS://Example.COM/a|Example.COM|=

https://h.example%40x/a|h.example%40x|=
https://h.example:443/a|h.example|=
https://:443/a|(unknown host)|(URL not shown)
https://h.example./a|h.example.|=
http:/x|(unknown host)|(URL not shown)
https:///x|(unknown host)|(URL not shown)
https://|(unknown host)|(URL not shown)

https:\u00ad//h.example/a|(unknown host)|(URL not shown)
